verdict.rationale: Motion's booking templates explicitly include reminders, so booking-tied reminders are a documented first-party capability. Nothing documents their channel (email or SMS), timing, multi-step sequences, or post-booking follow-ups. The AI Notetaker's action-item follow-ups are a separate post-meeting notes feature, not a no-show follow-up sequence. Missing for 10: documented email/SMS reminder channels, configurable multi-step reminder/follow-up sequences, post-booking follow-up automation, no-show handling, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, automated reminder and follow-up sequences (email/SMS) fire around every booking to cut no-shows

citations.quote: Client calls, board meetings, team all hands, sales demos—create a custom template for each with specific durations, pre-meeting questions, and reminders.
